purpose: Teach: フルタイム/所以/独禁法/両氏/所収/インタラクティブ/送受信/キャッチフレーズ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、フルタイム勤務の警官の負担を軽減されますね
lines.en: So the police are reducing the workload on full-time officers, then.
lines.style: Interested, conversational. Light acknowledgment on the opening. Warm and observational — noticing details without pushing. Steady pace, natural exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民に信頼される所以を磨かれますね
lines.en: And they're building up that trust with citizens that they're known for.
lines.style: Continuing the thought. Slight approving nod in the voice. Still warm, still easy. Not lecturing — just recognizing something good when he sees it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、独禁法違反の捜査も担当されますね
lines.en: They're handling antitrust investigations too, I see.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly impressed. Casual acknowledgment. Pace stays steady, conversational. The tone of someone cataloguing details as they go.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者両氏を別々に聴取されますね
lines.en: And interviewing suspects separately — that makes sense.
lines.style: Thoughtful, understated agreement. Slight pause before the dash, like he's processing. Warm but not overdoing it. Recognition of solid procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、判例所収の資料を活用されますね
lines.en: Using case precedent documents in their work, right.
lines.style: Agreeable but quieter now. Steady, almost reflective. Following the thread. Not enthusiastic, just present and tracking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民向けインタラクティブ広報を展開されますね
lines.en: They're rolling out interactive public outreach campaigns.
lines.style: Lighter shift in energy. Still warm, still easy company. Noticing something forward-thinking. Slight uptick in pace, genuine interest in the idea.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、無線送受信の暗号化を強化されますね
lines.en: Strengthening encryption on radio communications, too.
lines.style: Back to steady recognition. Approving undertone — practical stuff matters. Clear delivery, no flourish. Just noting another solid move.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯のキャッチフレーズを刷新されますね
lines.style: Closer now, almost confiding. Softer tone, more personal. A slight smile underneath. Like he's checking in with someone, not just listing facts. Warmer than the rest.
